title: Note close, statement
summary: One close per note: a 64px line from the note's own argument (a statement), the red System Audit button, the quiet Talk to the team, and one plain destination — the layer the note ends at.
story: The note ends at its layer (the story map's job for a note), and the line turns the note's argument into the reader's next step. The three notes' lines share no sentence shape.
